import numpy as np

adj = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Impute missing NO2 with global mean
mean_no2 = df['NO2_value'].mean(skipna=True)
df['NO2_value'] = df['NO2_value'].fillna(mean_no2)

# Compute global mean and std of NO2
mu = df['NO2_value'].mean()
sigma = df['NO2_value'].std(ddof=0)

# Standardized scores
df['z'] = (df['NO2_value'] - mu) / sigma

# Build adjacency dict
adj_dict = adj.groupby('borough')['neighbor'].apply(list).to_dict()

# Ensure neighbors exist in df
boroughs = set(df['borough'])
adj_clean = {
    b: [n for n in nbrs if n in boroughs]
    for b, nbrs in adj_dict.items()
}

# Compute neighbor means
z = df.set_index('borough')['z'].to_dict()
zbar = {}
for b, nbrs in adj_clean.items():
    if len(nbrs) > 0:
        zbar[b] = np.mean([z[n] for n in nbrs])

# Number of boroughs used
data_points_used = len(zbar)

# Identify candidates
hotspots = [b for b in zbar if z[b] > 0 and zbar[b] > 0]
coldspots = [b for b in zbar if z[b] < 0 and zbar[b] < 0]

# Permutation test
n_perm = 500
results = []
for b, kind in [(b, 'hot') for b in hotspots] + [(b, 'cold') for b in coldspots]:
    obs = zbar[b]
    perm_means = []
    zs = np.array(list(z.values()))
    borough_list = list(z.keys())
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        np.random.shuffle(zs)
        shuffled = dict(zip(borough_list, zs))
        nbrs = adj_clean[b]
        perm_means.append(np.mean([shuffled[n] for n in nbrs]))
    perm_means = np.array(perm_means)
    if kind == 'hot':
        p = np.mean(perm_means >= obs)
    else:
        p = np.mean(perm_means <= obs)
    if p < 0.05:
        results.append((b, kind, obs, p))

    entries = [
        f"{b} ({'HH' if kind=='hot' else 'LL'}, test_statistic={obs:.4f}, significance_measure={p:.4f})"
        for b, kind, obs, p in results
    ]

    final_line = "FINAL ANSWER: none"
